blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      description: Customer profitability metrics, scoring, and recommendations per customer and subsidiary based on converted_amount aggregations; final rows require total_revenue > 0.
      grain: One row per customer_id per subsidiary_id (after filtering to total_revenue > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: 'Build customer_transactions: - Join transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id. - Keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Income, COGS, Expense, or OthExpense. - Derive customer fields from entity_id: customer_id equals entity_id; customer_name as ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id; customer_email as ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id plus ''@example.com''. - Set customer_creation_date to the current date minus 365 days and customer_age_days to 365. - Categorize transactions by account_type_name: Income as Revenue; COGS as Cost_of_Sales; Expense and OthExpense as Operating_Expense. Aggregate to customer_metrics at the level of customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_age_days, subsidiary_id: - total_revenue: sum of converted_amount for Revenue transactions (signed). - total_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount for Cost_of_Sales. - allocated_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for Operating_Expense. - gross_profit: total_revenue minus total_cogs. - net_profit: gross_profit minus allocated_expenses. - transaction_count: distinct count of transaction_id. - active_months: distinct count of calendar months from accounting_period_ending. - first_transaction_date and last_transaction_date: earliest and latest accounting_period_ending. - average_order_value: total_revenue divided by transaction_count; use 0 when transaction_count is 0. Enrich in customer_segmentation: - gross_margin_pct: gross_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - net_margin_pct: net_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - customer_lifetime_months: months between first and last transaction, inclusive; use 1 when either date is missing. - customer_maturity from customer_age_days: under 90 days is New Customer; under 365 is Growing Relationship; under 1095 is Established Customer; otherwise Long-term Customer. - activity_status from days since last_transaction_date at run time: 30 or fewer is Highly Active; 31–90 is Active; 91–180 is At Risk; over 180 is Inactive. - analysis_date equals the current date. Score in customer_value_scoring: - revenue_score: 5 for total_revenue at or above the 80th percentile; 4 at or above the 60th; 3 at or above the 40th; 2 at or above the 20th; otherwise 1. Percentiles are computed over all rows in customer_segmentation (before the final filter). - frequency_score: 5 for 20 or more transactions; 4 for 10–19; 3 for 5–9; 2 for 2–4; otherwise 1. - margin_score: 5 for net_margin_pct at or above 0.30; 4 at or above 0.20; 3 at or above 0.10; 2 at or above 0.05; 1 for greater than 0; otherwise 0. Final computations and filter: - total_customer_score equals revenue_score plus frequency_score plus margin_score. - customer_segment: Champion for scores 12 or higher; Loyal for 9–11; Potential for 6–8; At Risk for 3–5; Lost for below 3. - predicted_clv: if customer_lifetime_months and active_months are both greater than 0, multiply net_profit per month by the larger of 12 months and 1.2 times customer_lifetime_months; otherwise use net_profit. - investment_recommendation: High Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.20 and activity_status is Highly Active or Active; Medium Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.10 and total_revenue exceeds the average total_revenue across customer_segmentation; Low Investment when net_margin_pct is greater than 0; otherwise Review Required. - Keep rows where customer_id is present and total_revenue is greater than 0. - customer_profitability_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by customer_id, an underscore, and subsidiary_id; it is null if either component is null.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_profitability_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of customer_id + '_' + subsidiary_id; null when either component is null; unique per (customer_id, subsidiary_id).
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from transaction lines; final rows require non-null.
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic name: ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id.'
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic email: ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id and ''@example.com''.'
      - name: customer_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Current date minus 365 days at run time for all rows.
      - name: customer_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 365 representing days since customer_creation_date.
      - name: customer_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucket from customer_age_days: New (<90), Growing (<365), Established (<1095), Long-term (otherwise).'
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary from transaction details; may be null; part of the row grain and ID hash.
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Signed sum of converted_amount for Revenue transactions; final rows require > 0.
      - name: total_cogs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Cost_of_Sales; non-negative.
      - name: allocated_expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Operating_Expense; non-negative.
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_revenue minus total_cogs; may be negative.
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: gross_profit minus allocated_expenses; may be negative.
      - name: gross_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: gross_profit divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0; ratio not a formatted percent.
      - name: net_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: net_profit divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0; ratio not a formatted percent.
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of transaction_id across included categories; at least 1 in final rows.
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of calendar months present in accounting_period_ending; at least 1.
      - name: customer_lifetime_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Inclusive months between first and last transaction; 1 when either date is missing.
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending for the customer and subsidiary.
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending for the customer and subsidiary.
      - name: average_order_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_revenue divided by transaction_count when transaction_count > 0, else 0.
      - name: revenue_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score based on total_revenue percentiles across customer_segmentation: 80th+→5, 60th+→4, 40th+→3, 20th+→2, otherwise 1.'
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score from transaction_count thresholds: 20+→5; 10–19→4; 5–9→3; 2–4→2; otherwise 1.'
      - name: margin_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score from net_margin_pct thresholds: ≥0.30→5; ≥0.20→4; ≥0.10→3; ≥0.05→2; >0→1; otherwise 0.'
      - name: total_customer_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of revenue_score, frequency_score, and margin_score.
      - name: customer_segment

business_logic: 'Build customer_transactions: - Join transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id. - Keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Income, COGS, Expense, or OthExpense. - Derive customer fields from entity_id: customer_id equals entity_id; customer_name as ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id; customer_email as ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id plus ''@example.com''. - Set customer_creation_date to the current date minus 365 days and customer_age_days to 365. - Categorize transactions by account_type_name: Income as Revenue; COGS as Cost_of_Sales; Expense and OthExpense as Operating_Expense. Aggregate to customer_metrics at the level of customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_age_days, subsidiary_id: - total_revenue: sum of converted_amount for Revenue transactions (signed). - total_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount for Cost_of_Sales. - allocated_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for Operating_Expense. - gross_profit: total_revenue minus total_cogs. - net_profit: gross_profit minus allocated_expenses. - transaction_count: distinct count of transaction_id. - active_months: distinct count of calendar months from accounting_period_ending. - first_transaction_date and last_transaction_date: earliest and latest accounting_period_ending. - average_order_value: total_revenue divided by transaction_count; use 0 when transaction_count is 0. Enrich in customer_segmentation: - gross_margin_pct: gross_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - net_margin_pct: net_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - customer_lifetime_months: months between first and last transaction, inclusive; use 1 when either date is missing. - customer_maturity from customer_age_days: under 90 days is New Customer; under 365 is Growing Relationship; under 1095 is Established Customer; otherwise Long-term Customer. - activity_status from days since last_transaction_date at run time: 30 or fewer is Highly Active; 31–90 is Active; 91–180 is At Risk; over 180 is Inactive. - analysis_date equals the current date. Score in customer_value_scoring: - revenue_score: 5 for total_revenue at or above the 80th percentile; 4 at or above the 60th; 3 at or above the 40th; 2 at or above the 20th; otherwise 1. Percentiles are computed over all rows in customer_segmentation (before the final filter). - frequency_score: 5 for 20 or more transactions; 4 for 10–19; 3 for 5–9; 2 for 2–4; otherwise 1. - margin_score: 5 for net_margin_pct at or above 0.30; 4 at or above 0.20; 3 at or above 0.10; 2 at or above 0.05; 1 for greater than 0; otherwise 0. Final computations and filter: - total_customer_score equals revenue_score plus frequency_score plus margin_score. - customer_segment: Champion for scores 12 or higher; Loyal for 9–11; Potential for 6–8; At Risk for 3–5; Lost for below 3. - predicted_clv: if customer_lifetime_months and active_months are both greater than 0, multiply net_profit per month by the larger of 12 months and 1.2 times customer_lifetime_months; otherwise use net_profit. - investment_recommendation: High Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.20 and activity_status is Highly Active or Active; Medium Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.10 and total_revenue exceeds the average total_revenue across customer_segmentation; Low Investment when net_margin_pct is greater than 0; otherwise Review Required. - Keep rows where customer_id is present and total_revenue is greater than 0. - customer_profitability_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by customer_id, an underscore, and subsidiary_id; it is null if either component is null.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__customers
      description: Customer records enriched with city, state, zipcode, and country from the selected default address (billing preferred over shipping).
      grain: One row per customer_id; duplicates may occur if multiple entity_address rows share the selected address key; no deduplication.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__entity_address
      business_logic: '- Load all fields from staging.stg_netsuite2__customers. - Select the default address key: use default_billing_address_id when present; otherwise use default_shipping_address_id; if both are NULL, no address key is available. - Left join staging.stg_netsuite2__entity_address on the chosen address key matching entity_address.nkey. - Include city, state, zipcode, and country from the matched address; if no match, these four fields are NULL. - No filtering, aggregation, or ordering is applied; row multiplicity follows the join and duplicates can occur if multiple address rows share the selected nkey.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary customer identifier sourced from customers staging.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: entity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Entity identifier sourced from customers staging.
      - name: customer_external_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: External identifier sourced from customers staging.
      - name: parent_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent customer identifier sourced from customers staging.
      - name: is_person
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Person vs. company flag sourced from customers staging.
      - name: alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternate display name sourced from customers staging.
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name sourced from customers staging.
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name sourced from customers staging.
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name sourced from customers staging.
      - name: email_address
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address sourced from customers staging; no transformation applied.
      - name: phone_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone number sourced from customers staging; no transformation applied.
      - name: default_billing_address_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Default billing address ID; chosen first when determining the address key for the join.
      - name: default_shipping_address_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Default shipping address ID; used as the address key only when billing ID is absent.
      - name: receivables_account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Receivables account identifier sourced from customers staging.
      - name: currency_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Home currency identifier sourced from customers staging.
      - name: date_first_order_at
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of first order sourced from customers staging.
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from the matched default address; NULL if no address match.
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/region from the matched default address; NULL if no address match.
      - name: zipcode
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Postal code from the matched default address; NULL if no address match.
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country from the matched default address; NULL if no address match.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics
      description: Comprehensive NetSuite data quality outputs combining an overall assessment with detailed per-table statistics and referential integrity checks
      grain: One row per report entry (overall assessment, table statistics, or integrity check)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__entities
      business_logic: 'Compile intermediate checks and summarize into a final unioned report ordered by report_type and quality_grade (ascending): - source_table_stats (per source table snapshot with current time): - Transactions: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_id; counts of null transaction_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_date (null_dates), null entity_id (null_subsidiaries), null status (null_status); earliest_date = minimum transaction_date; latest_date = maximum transaction_date. - Transaction lines: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_line_id; counts of null transaction_line_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_id (null_foreign_keys), null entity_id twice for both null_accounts and null_amounts; earliest_transaction = minimum transaction_id; latest_transaction = maximum transaction_id. - Customers: total records; unique records by distinct customer_id; counts of null customer_id (null_primary_keys), null company_name (null_names), null email_address (null_emails), null date_first_order_at (null_creation_dates); unique_names = distinct company_name count; unique_emails = distinct email_address count. - referential_integrity_checks (three left-join checks; integrity percentages rounded to two decimals): - transaction_lines_to_transactions: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined transaction_ids; orphaned = base minus matched; integrity = matched/base × 100 (two decimals); timestamp = current time. - transaction_lines_to_entities: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - transactions_to_entities: base = transactions; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - business_rule_validations (four rules; compliance percentages rounded to two decimals; timestamp = current time): - transaction_id_uniqueness: violations = total transactions minus distinct transaction_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - customer_id_uniqueness: violations = total customers minus distinct customer_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - future_transaction_dates: violations = transactions with date more than one day in the future; compliance = transactions with date not more than one day in the future divided by total × 100. - balanced_journal_entries: sum netamount per transaction_id; violations = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount greater than 0.01; compliance = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount at most 0.01 divided by total × 100. - data_completeness_analysis (customers_contact_info and transaction_lines_account_assignment) is computed but not used in final output. - overall_quality_summary (single row): - completeness_score = average across source_table_stats of: for transactions, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_subsidiaries) equals 0 else 70; for customers, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_names) equals 0 else 70; otherwise (e.g., transaction_lines) 85. - consistency_score = average integrity_percentage across referential_integrity_checks. - accuracy_score = average compliance_percentage across business_rule_validations. - assessment_timestamp = current time. - Final output (UNION ALL): - Overall row (report_type = ''Data Quality Assessment''): - overall_quality_score = average of completeness, consistency, and accuracy scores, rounded to two decimals. - quality_grade: Excellent (>= 95), Good (>= 85), Fair (>= 70), Poor (>= 50), otherwise Critical. - primary_concern: first applicable—Data Completeness Issues if completeness_score < 80; else Referential Integrity Issues if consistency_score < 80; else Business Rule Violations if accuracy_score < 80; else No Major Issues. - recommended_action: Immediate Data Cleansing Required if overall_quality_score < 70; Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended if < 85; otherwise Maintain Current Data Quality Standards. - tables_assessed = number of source_table_stats rows; integrity_checks_performed = number of referential_integrity_checks rows; business_rules_validated = number of business_rule_validations rows. - quality_assessment_id = MD5 of the assessment_timestamp as text. - Table Statistics rows (one per source_table_stats row; report_type = ''Table Statistics''): - quality_grade = table_name. - primary_concern = "Records: {total_records}, Unique: {unique_records}, Null PKs: {null_primary_keys}". - recommended_action: - Transactions: "Date Range: {earliest_date} to {latest_date}". - Transaction lines: "Date Range: {earliest_transaction} to {latest_transaction}" (transaction_id values). - Customers: "Date Range: {unique_names} to {unique_emails}" (distinct counts occupying those positions). - If any concatenated component is null, the whole string is null. - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of table_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Integrity Checks rows (one per referential_integrity_checks row; report_type = ''Integrity Checks''): - overall_quality_score = integrity_percentage (two decimals). - quality_grade = check_name. - primary_concern = "Matched: {matched}/{total}" using the matched join count over the base record count of the check. - recommended_action = "Orphaned Records: {orphaned_records}". - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of check_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Final ordering: by report_type then quality_grade ascending; casing and spacing in constructed strings are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: report_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row category: ''Data Quality Assessment'', ''Table Statistics'', or ''Integrity Checks'' (controls which metric columns are populated)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: completeness_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall completeness score from overall_quality_summary (unrounded average per rules); NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: consistency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall consistency score as average of referential integrity percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: accuracy_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall accuracy score as average of business rule compliance percentages; NULL for non-overall rows
      - name: overall_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Overall row: average of the three scores rounded to two decimals; Integrity rows: integrity percentage; Table Statistics: NULL'
      - name: quality_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall row: grade bucket (Excellent/Good/Fair/Poor/Critical); detail rows: table_name or check_name'
      - name: primary_concern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: dominant issue per precedence; Table Statistics: ''Records: X, Unique: Y, Null PKs: Z''; Integrity: ''Matched: matched/total'''
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall: action by thresholds; Table Statistics: date range or positional counts; Integrity: ''Orphaned Records: N'''
      - name: tables_assessed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of source tables assessed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: integrity_checks_performed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of referential integrity checks performed (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: business_rules_validated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of business rules validated (present only in overall row; NULL otherwise)
      - name: assessment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp of the assessment or check snapshot based on current time
      - name: quality_assessment_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Row-unique MD5 identifier seeded by report-specific fields and timestamp (overall: timestamp; table stats: table_name+timestamp; integrity: check_name+timestamp)'
        constraints:
        - not_null
        - unique

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      description: Liquidity, profitability, and efficiency metrics by subsidiary for the latest balance-sheet period with 12-month income aggregation
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id per accounting_period_id (latest accounting_period_ending only)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__balance_sheet
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__income_statement
      business_logic: '- From the balance sheet, keep only rows where accounting_period_ending equals the global maximum date; aggregate period_balance as the sum of converted_amount by subsidiary_id, account_type_name, accounting_period_id, and accounting_period_ending. - Current assets by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id (from period_balance): - total_current_assets: sum for account types Bank, AcctRec, UnbilledRec, OthCurrAsset (signed as stored). - cash_and_equivalents: sum for account type Bank. - accounts_receivable: sum for account types AcctRec and UnbilledRec. - Current liabilities by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id: - total_current_liabilities: sum of the absolute values of period_balance for account types AcctPay, CredCard, OthCurrLiab (non-negative total). - Equity by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id: - total_equity: sum for account types Equity, Retained Earnings, Net Income. - From the income statement, keep rows within the last 12 months from today and aggregate by subsidiary_id: - total_revenue: sum where account type is Income. - total_cogs: sum where account type is COGS. - net_income: sum where account type is one of Income, COGS, Expense, OthIncome, OthExpense. - Join logic: current_assets left join current_liabilities and total_equity on subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id; left join income_metrics on subsidiary_id only. - Ratios (no rounding; result is NULL when the denominator is NULL or <= 0): - current_ratio: total_current_assets divided by total_current_liabilities. - quick_ratio: (cash_and_equivalents + accounts_receivable) divided by total_current_liabilities. - cash_ratio: cash_and_equivalents divided by total_current_liabilities. - return_on_equity: net_income divided by total_equity (uses 12-month net income with latest-period equity). - gross_margin_ratio: (total_revenue − total_cogs) divided by total_revenue. - net_profit_margin: net_income divided by total_revenue. - receivables_turnover: total_revenue divided by accounts_receivable (uses period-end AR, not an average). - calculation_date is set to today’s date. - Scores (integers in {0,20,40,60,80,100}; NULL ratios fall to 0 via the default case): - liquidity_score from current_ratio: >=2.0→100, >=1.5→80, >=1.0→60, >=0.8→40, >=0.5→20, else 0. - profitability_score from net_profit_margin: >=0.15→100, >=0.10→80, >=0.05→60, >=0.02→40, >=0→20, else 0. - efficiency_score from receivables_turnover: >=12→100, >=8→80, >=6→60, >=4→40, >=2→20, else 0. - overall_financial_health_score: average of the three scores rounded to two decimals. - financial_health_grade: derived from the rounded overall score (>=80 Excellent, >=60 Good, >=40 Fair, >=20 Poor, else Critical). - financial_ratios_id: MD5 hash of subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id joined with an underscore. - Final filter: drop rows where subsidiary_id is null.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier sourced from balance sheet; non-null after final filter
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period identifier for the globally latest accounting_period_ending in the balance sheet
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: current_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total current assets divided by total current liabilities; NULL if liabilities are NULL or <= 0; no rounding
      - name: quick_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cash and equivalents plus accounts receivable divided by total current liabilities; NULL if liabilities are NULL or <= 0; no rounding
      - name: cash_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cash and equivalents divided by total current liabilities; NULL if liabilities are NULL or <= 0; no rounding
      - name: return_on_equity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net income over total equity; NULL if equity is NULL or <= 0; uses 12-month net income and latest-period equity
      - name: gross_margin_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross profit (revenue minus COGS) divided by revenue; NULL if revenue is NULL or <= 0; no rounding
      - name: net_profit_margin
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net income divided by revenue over the last 12 months; NULL if revenue is NULL or <= 0; no rounding
      - name: receivables_turnover
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 12-month revenue divided by latest-period accounts receivable; NULL if AR is NULL or <= 0; uses period-end AR
      - name: total_current_assets
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of period_balance for account types Bank, AcctRec, UnbilledRec, OthCurrAsset in the latest global period (signed as stored)
      - name: total_current_liabilities
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute period_balance for account types AcctPay, CredCard, OthCurrLiab in the latest global period (non-negative)
      - name: cash_and_equivalents
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of period_balance for account type Bank in the latest global period
      - name: accounts_receivable
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of period_balance for account types AcctRec and UnbilledRec in the latest global period
      - name: total_equity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of period_balance for account types Equity, Retained Earnings, Net Income in the latest global period
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum where account type is Income over the last 12 months by subsidiary
      - name: total_cogs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum where account type is COGS over the last 12 months by subsidiary
      - name: net_income
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum where account type is one of Income, COGS, Expense, OthIncome, OthExpense over the last 12 months
      - name: calculation_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Evaluation date set to today
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: liquidity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score from current_ratio using thresholds: >=2.0 100, >=1.5 80, >=1.0 60, >=0.8 40, >=0.5 20, else 0'
      - name: profitability_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score from net_profit_margin using thresholds: >=0.15 100, >=0.10 80, >=0.05 60, >=0.02 40, >=0 20, else 0'
      - name: efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score from receivables_turnover using thresholds: >=12 100, >=8 80, >=6 60, >=4 40, >=2 20, else 0'
      - name: overall_financial_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of the three scores rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: financial_health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Grade from the rounded overall score: >=80 Excellent, >=60 Good, >=40 Fair, >=20 Poor, else Critical'
      - name: financial_ratios_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id joined by an underscore; unique per row
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

CASE WHEN current_ratio >= 2 THEN 100 WHEN current_ratio >= 1.5 THEN 80 WHEN current_ratio >= 1 THEN 60 WHEN current_ratio >= 0.8 THEN 40 WHEN current_ratio >= 0.5 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.15 THEN 100 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.1 THEN 80 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.05 THEN 60 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.02 THEN 40 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN receivables_turnover >= 12 THEN 100 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 8 THEN 80 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 6 THEN 60 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 4 THEN 40 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN (liquidity_score + profitability_score + efficiency_score) / 3.0 >= 80 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN (liquidity_score + profitability_score + efficiency_score) / 3.0 >= 60 THEN 'Good' WHEN (liquidity_score + profitability_score + efficiency_score) / 3.0 >= 40 THEN 'Fair' WHEN (liquidity_score + profitability_score + efficiency_score) / 3.0 >= 20 THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Critical' END

left join income_metrics on subsidiary_id only. - Ratios (no rounding; result is NULL when the denominator is NULL or <= 0): - current_ratio: total_current_assets divided by total_current_liabilities. - quick_ratio: (cash_and_equivalents + accounts_receivable) divided by total_current_liabilities. - cash_ratio: cash_and_equivalents divided by total_current_liabilities. - return_on_equity: net_income divided by total_equity (uses 12-month net income with latest-period equity). - gross_margin_ratio: (total_revenue − total_cogs) divided by total_revenue. - net_profit_margin: net_income divided by total_revenue. - receivables_turnover: total_revenue divided by accounts_receivable (uses period-end AR, not an average). - calculation_date is set to today’s date. - Scores (integers in {0,20,40,60,80,100}; NULL ratios fall to 0 via the default case): - liquidity_score from current_ratio: >=2.0→100, >=1.5→80, >=1.0→60, >=0.8→40, >=0.5→20, else 0. - profitability_score from net_profit_margin: >=0.15→100, >=0.10→80, >=0.05→60, >=0.02→40, >=0→20, else 0. - efficiency_score from receivables_turnover: >=12→100, >=8→80, >=6→60, >=4→40, >=2→20, else 0. - overall_financial_health_score: average of the three scores rounded to two decimals. - financial_health_grade: derived from the rounded overall score (>=80 Excellent, >=60 Good, >=40 Fair, >=20 Poor, else Critical). - financial_ratios_id: MD5 hash of subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id joined with an underscore. - Final filter: drop rows where subsidiary_id is null.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__income_statement
      description: Income statement lines with joined dimensions and converted amounts for profitability analysis
      grain: One row per transaction_id + transaction_line_id for income-statement transactions in their reporting period
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts. - Inner join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines on both transaction_id and transaction_line_id to bring line-level attributes. - Left join dimensions: - Accounts by account_id. - Accounting periods (as reporting_accounting_periods) by reporting_accounting_period_id. - Subsidiaries by subsidiary_id, then currencies by subsidiaries.currency_id to get the subsidiary currency symbol. - Classes by class_id, locations by location_id, and departments by department_id from the transaction line. - Keep only rows where is_income_statement is true and the transaction accounting period equals the reporting accounting period. - Select identifiers and attributes from the joined tables, including reporting period, account, subsidiary, class, location, department, and account_category. - Derivations: - account_number_and_name: join account_number and account_name with a single "-" (no spaces); if either input is NULL, the result is NULL. - income_statement_sort_helper: map the lowercase account_type_name as income→1, cogs→2, expense→3, othincome→4, othexpense→5; otherwise NULL. - converted_amount: negate converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period; transaction_amount: negate unconverted_amount; NULLs propagate. - Surrogate key income_statement_id: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, accounting_period_id, and account_name joined by underscores; if any component is NULL, the key is NULL. - No aggregation or de-duplication is performed; duplicates from sources are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: income_statement_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, accounting_period_id, and account_name joined with '_' (NULL in any component yields NULL)
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction line identifier aligned via int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting accounting period identifier from int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting accounting period end date
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting accounting period name
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the reporting accounting period is an adjustment period
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the reporting accounting period is closed
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type name from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from the accounts dimension
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the subsidiary associated with the transaction
      - name: subsidiary_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary full name from staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - name: subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary short name from staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - name: subsidiary_currency_symbol
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency symbol of the transaction’s subsidiary from staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      - name: account_number_and_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: account_number and account_name joined by '-' with no spaces; NULL if either part is NULL
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class identifier from the transaction line
      - name: class_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full class name from staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      - name: location_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location identifier from the transaction line
      - name: location_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full location name from staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from the transaction line
      - name: department_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full department name from staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account category copied from int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - name: income_statement_sort_helper
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Sort rank from account_type_name (lowercased): income=1, cogs=2, expense=3, othincome=4, othexpense=5; else NULL'
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Negated converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period (NULL if source is NULL)
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Negated unconverted_amount (NULL if source is NULL)

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__supplier_credit_monitoring
      description: Supplier credit monitoring and risk assessment per vendor-subsidiary derived from Netsuite transaction details and lines
      grain: One row per (vendor_id, subsidiary_id) where vendor_id is not null and total_expenses > 0
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: '1) Build vendor_transactions by joining transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Payable, AcctPay, Expense, OthExpense, Bank. - Derive vendor fields deterministically from entity_id: vendor_id = entity_id; vendor_name = "Vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email = "vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id + "@supplier.com"; vendor_creation_date is 730 days before the run date; vendor_relationship_days = 730. - Classify transaction_category: Payable for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; Expense for Expense or OthExpense; Payment for Bank; otherwise Other. - Set payment_status: Paid for Bank; Outstanding for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; otherwise Other. 2) Aggregate vendor_payment_behavior grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_creation_date, vendor_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_payables: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payable; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_payments: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payment; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Expense; NULL amounts do not contribute. - outstanding_balance: sum of absolute converted_amount for rows with payment_status Outstanding; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id across all grouped rows. - payment_transactions: count of rows classified as Payment where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows with payment_status Outstanding where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows with payment_status Outstanding. - last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows classified as Payment. 3) Compute vendor_risk_metrics: - payment_ratio: total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables is positive; otherwise 0. - avg_payment_delay_days: if there is at least one payment transaction, set to 15 plus a deterministic offset from 0 to 29 based on vendor_id, yielding 15–44; otherwise NULL. - relationship_duration_months: number of calendar months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; otherwise 1. - vendor_activity_status: Active if the last transaction is within 30 days of the run date; Recent if within 90; Dormant if within 180; otherwise Inactive; if last_transaction_date is NULL, treat as Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days elapsed since last_outstanding_date; if it does not exist, set to 0. 4) Compute vendor_credit_scoring: - payment_performance_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else. - payment_timeliness_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL delay yields 1. - relationship_stability_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else. - transaction_frequency_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for total_transactions ≥50/≥25/≥10/≥5/else. 5) Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the four component scores. - credit_rating: AAA/AA/A/BBB/BB for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_balance exceeds 30% of total_expenses and days_since_last_outstanding >60; Medium Risk if exceeds 20% and >45; Low Risk if outstanding_balance >0 and >30; otherwise Minimal Risk (evaluated in this order). - recommended_credit_limit: total_expenses multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - monitoring_date: the run date. - supplier_monitoring_id: MD5 hash of vendor_id and subsidiary_id joined by an underscore. - Filter final rows to vendor_id present and total_expenses > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from transaction_lines.entity_id; not null; grouping key with subsidiary_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic name 'Vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id; deterministic per vendor_id
      - name: vendor_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic email 'vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id + '@supplier.com'; deterministic per vendor_id
      - name: vendor_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp 730 days before the run date; constant per run
      - name: vendor_relationship_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 730 representing relationship age in days
      - name: relationship_duration_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; else 1
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction details; groups output with vendor_id
      - name: total_payables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payable transactions; NULL amounts excluded; no rounding
      - name: total_payments
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions; NULL amounts excluded; no rounding
      - name: total_expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Expense transactions; NULL amounts excluded; filtered to > 0
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount where payment_status is Outstanding; NULL amounts excluded
      - name: payment_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables > 0; else 0
      - name: avg_payment_delay_days
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: If payment_transactions > 0 then deterministic integer in 15–44 based on vendor_id; else NULL
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct transaction_id across joined rows
      - name: payment_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows classified as Payment with non-NULL transaction_id; not distinct
      - name: outstanding_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows with payment_status Outstanding and non-NULL transaction_id; not distinct
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending per group
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending per group
      - name: last_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending among Payment transactions; NULL if none
      - name: last_outstanding_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending among Outstanding transactions; NULL if none
      - name: days_since_last_outstanding
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days elapsed since last_outstanding_date; 0 if no Outstanding exists
      - name: payment_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio thresholds ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else
      - name: payment_timeliness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days thresholds ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL yields 1
      - name: relationship_stability_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months thresholds ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else
      - name: transaction_frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for total_transactions thresholds ≥50/≥25/≥10/≥5/else
      - name: total_credit_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of payment_performance_score, payment_timeliness_score, relationship_stability_score, and transaction_frequency_score
      - name: credit_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: AAA/AA/A/BBB/BB based on total_credit_score thresholds ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High/Medium/Low/Minimal Risk based on outstanding_balance vs total_expenses (30%/20/>0) and days since last outstanding (>60/>45/>30), evaluated in order
      - name: vendor_activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active if last_transaction_date within 30 days of run date; Recent within 90; Dormant within 180; else Inactive; NULL last_transaction_date -> Inactive
      - name: recommended_credit_limit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_expenses multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 according to total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else
      - name: monitoring_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Run date; same for all rows in a run
      - name: supplier_monitoring_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of vendor_id and subsidiary_id joined by underscore; 32-character; unique per (vendor_id, subsidiary_id)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

- name: int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods
      description: Identity mapping of accounting periods to reporting periods for mock data
      grain: One row per source accounting_periods row (no deduplication)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods (no filters, no joins). - For each input row, emit: - accounting_period_id = accounting_period_id from the source row. - reporting_accounting_period_id = the same accounting_period_id value (identity mapping). - No additional transformations: - Duplicates from the source are preserved; no DISTINCT or aggregation. - NULL values are preserved as-is. - No ordering is enforced.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period identifier copied 1:1 from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods; duplicates and NULLs are preserved
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period identifier set equal to accounting_period_id for each row; duplicates and NULLs mirror the source accounting_period_id

- name: int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period
      description: Transaction lines with a cyclically assigned accounting period and amount defaulted to 0 when NULL
      grain: One row per transaction line record from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines and assign each a sequential position (tl_row) with no specified ordering. - Read all rows from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods and assign each a sequential position (period_row) with no specified ordering. - Let N be the number of available accounting periods. If N = 0 the query fails because the period assignment requires a modulo calculation. - For each transaction line at position k, assign the accounting period whose position is the remainder of (k - 1) divided by N, plus one. This cycles through the period list repeatedly in its arbitrary order, assigning exactly one period to each line when N >= 1. - Output one row per transaction line: pass through transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, and account_id unchanged; set transaction_accounting_period_id to the assigned period’s accounting_period_id; set unconverted_amount to 0 when the source line amount is NULL, otherwise use the original amount. No aggregation, filtering, rounding, or de-duplication is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the source transaction; passed through from transaction lines without transformation
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the transaction line; passed through from transaction lines without transformation
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier for the line; passed through from transaction lines; may be NULL
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier for the line; passed through from transaction lines; may be NULL
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period id assigned by cycling through available periods based on the transaction line’s position; ordering is arbitrary due to unordered row numbering; may be NULL if the source period id is NULL
      - name: unconverted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount with NULLs defaulted to 0; no rounding or currency conversion applied
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      description: Transaction lines replicated by reporting period with pass-through amounts and account classifications.
      grain: One row per combination of transaction_line_id and reporting_accounting_period_id; if no mapping, reporting_accounting_period_id is NULL.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_lines_w_accounting_period. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_and_reporting_periods on transaction_accounting_period_id = accounting_period_id to add reporting_accounting_period_id; all transaction lines are retained, NULL is set when no mapping exists, and multiple rows can result if the mapping table has duplicates for a given accounting period. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts on account_id to classify accounts: * is_income_statement is TRUE when the account type (compared case-insensitively) is one of income, othincome, expense, othexpense, or cogs; otherwise FALSE, including when the type is missing. * account_category (case-insensitive type match): - Asset for acctrec, bank, deferexpense, fixedasset, othasset, othcurrasset, unbilledrec - Expense for cogs, expense, othexpense - Income for income, othincome - Liability for acctpay, credcard, deferrevenue, longtermliab, othcurrliab - Equity for equity, retained_earnings, net_income - Other for nonposting, stat - NULL when no type or no match. - Set converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period = unconverted_amount (no conversion; NULL propagates). - Set converted_amount_using_reporting_month = unconverted_amount (no conversion; NULL propagates). - Create tran_with_converted_amounts_id by MD5 hashing the concatenation of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, account_id, and reporting_accounting_period_id joined with "_" in that order; if any component is NULL, the concatenation and the id are NULL; component values are used as-is without trimming or case changes.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction identifier passed through from transaction lines.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction line identifier used for row grain and surrogate key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction lines; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier used to join to account attributes; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: transaction_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period of the transaction line used to map reporting periods; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: unconverted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Original transaction amount in transaction currency; values are passed through; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period derived from transaction_accounting_period_id; NULL if no mapping; duplicates possible if the mapping table has multiple rows per accounting period.
      - name: converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Equal to unconverted_amount with no exchange rate applied; NULL when unconverted_amount is NULL.
      - name: converted_amount_using_reporting_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Equal to unconverted_amount with no exchange rate applied; NULL when unconverted_amount is NULL.
      - name: is_income_statement
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE when account type is income, othincome, expense, othexpense, or cogs (case-insensitive); otherwise FALSE, including when type is missing.
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Category derived from account type (case-insensitive) per defined sets; NULL when unmatched or type is missing.
      - name: tran_with_converted_amounts_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, account_id, and reporting_accounting_period_id concatenated with '_' in that order; NULL if any component is NULL.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      description: Transaction lines with cyclical account assignment and derived amounts/flags
      grain: One row per input row in staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__accounts
      business_logic: '- Load all rows from staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines; no filtering or de-duplication. - Assign a sequential number tl_row to each transaction line starting at 1; ordering is undefined without an explicit sort. - From staging.stg_netsuite2__accounts, assign a sequential number account_row to each account starting at 1; let total_accounts be the count of accounts. - Requires total_accounts ≥ 1; if 0, the modulus-based selection causes the query to fail (division by zero). - For each transaction line, select exactly one account by cycling through accounts in sequence: line 1 -> account 1, line 2 -> account 2, …, line N -> account N, then wrap back to account 1 and repeat. The assignment depends on the undefined ordering of both sequences. - Derivations: - exchange_rate: fixed at 1.0. - amount: equal to netamount. - credit_amount: 0 when netamount is positive; otherwise the absolute value of netamount; becomes NULL when netamount is NULL. - debit_amount: netamount when netamount is positive; otherwise 0; becomes 0 when netamount is NULL. - paid_amount: fixed at 0. - unpaid_amount: fixed at 0. - is_posting: fixed TRUE. - Output all original transaction line fields plus the computed fields above.'

- name: int_netsuite__transaction_and_reporting_periods
      description: Mapping of non-quarter, non-year base accounting periods to same-calendar reporting periods that start on/after the base and are not in the future.
      grain: One row per (accounting_period_id, reporting_accounting_period_id) pair
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      business_logic: '- Load accounting_periods from staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods and subsidiaries from staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries. - Select base periods where: - quarter is false - year_0 is false - fiscal_calendar_id exists in subsidiaries (distinct fiscal_calendar_id). - For each base period, join to multiplier periods from the same accounting_periods table where: - fiscal_calendar_id matches the base - quarter matches the base (both false) - year_0 matches the base (both false) - starting_at of the multiplier is on or after the base starting_at (as stored in the source) - the multiplier''s starting_at, truncated to seconds and interpreted as a timestamp, is not later than the current time at evaluation. - Emit one row per qualifying pair: - accounting_period_id = base.accounting_period_id - reporting_accounting_period_id = multiplier.accounting_period_id - No ordering, aggregation, or de-duplication is applied; duplicates from source are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the base non-quarter, non-year accounting period in a subsidiary fiscal calendar; may appear in multiple rows paired with later or equal reporting periods.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of a non-quarter, non-year reporting period in the same fiscal calendar that starts on or after the base and is not in the future when evaluated.
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: int_netsuite__transactions_with_converted_amounts
      description: Transaction lines enriched with reporting period, exchange rates for transaction and reporting periods, converted amounts, and account-based flags.
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_lines_w_accounting_period

      - intermediate.int_netsuite__accountxperiod_exchange_rate_map

      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_lines_w_accounting_period (one row per transaction line with transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, account_id, transaction_accounting_period_id, unconverted_amount). - Inner join to intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_and_reporting_periods on transaction_accounting_period_id to obtain reporting_accounting_period_id; rows without a match are excluded. - Inner join to intermediate.int_netsuite__accountxperiod_exchange_rate_map twice to attach exchange rates: - Reporting-period rate: match on reporting_accounting_period_id (as accounting period), account_id, and from_subsidiary_id = subsidiary_id; output as exchange_rate_reporting_period. - Transaction-period rate: match on transaction_accounting_period_id (as accounting period), account_id, and from_subsidiary_id = subsidiary_id; output as exchange_rate_transaction_period. - Both joins are required; rows missing either rate are excluded. - Compute converted amounts by multiplying unconverted_amount by the corresponding exchange rate after converting both to numeric; no rounding is applied, the sign is preserved, and the result is NULL if either input is NULL. - Left join staging.stg_netsuite__accounts on account_id to derive: - is_income_statement: TRUE when type_name (case-insensitive) is one of income, other income, expense, other expense, or cost of goods sold; otherwise FALSE (including NULL). - account_category from type_name (case-insensitive): Asset (accounts receivable, bank, deferred expense, fixed asset, other asset, other current asset, unbilled receivable, prepaid expense), Expense (cost of goods sold, expense, other expense), Income (income, other income), Liability (accounts payable, credit card, deferred revenue, long term liability, other current liability), Equity (equity, retained earnings, net income), Other (non posting, statistical); else NULL. - Output includes all base and derived fields; one row per transaction_line_id that meets the inner-join conditions.'

      - name: unconverted_amount

        description: Original line amount before conversion; if NULL, both converted amounts are NULL.
      - name: reporting_accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Reporting period mapped from transaction_accounting_period_id via the period mapping table.
      - name: exchange_rate_reporting_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Exchange rate for the reporting period matched by reporting_accounting_period_id, account_id, and subsidiary; stored as text and used for conversion.
      - name: exchange_rate_transaction_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Exchange rate for the transaction accounting period matched by transaction_accounting_period_id, account_id, and subsidiary; stored as text and used for conversion.
      - name: converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Product of unconverted_amount and the transaction-period exchange rate after numeric conversion; no rounding; NULL if either input is NULL.
      - name: converted_amount_using_reporting_month

      - name: is_income_statement

      - name: account_category

alternatives.expression_sql: COALESCE(LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('income', 'other income', 'expense', 'other expense', 'cost of goods sold'), FALSE)

CASE WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('accounts receivable', 'bank', 'deferred expense', 'fixed asset', 'other asset', 'other current asset', 'unbilled receivable', 'prepaid expense') THEN 'Asset' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('cost of goods sold', 'expense', 'other expense') THEN 'Expense' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('income', 'other income') THEN 'Income' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('accounts payable', 'credit card', 'deferred revenue', 'long term liability', 'other current liability') THEN 'Liability' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('equity', 'retained earnings', 'net income') THEN 'Equity' WHEN LOWER(a.type_name) IN ('non posting', 'statistical') THEN 'Other' END

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_lines_w_accounting_period (one row per transaction line with transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, account_id, transaction_accounting_period_id, unconverted_amount). - Inner join to intermediate.int_netsuite__transaction_and_reporting_periods on transaction_accounting_period_id to obtain reporting_accounting_period_id; rows without a match are excluded. - Inner join to intermediate.int_netsuite__accountxperiod_exchange_rate_map twice to attach exchange rates: - Reporting-period rate: match on reporting_accounting_period_id (as accounting period), account_id, and from_subsidiary_id = subsidiary_id; output as exchange_rate_reporting_period. - Transaction-period rate: match on transaction_accounting_period_id (as accounting period), account_id, and from_subsidiary_id = subsidiary_id; output as exchange_rate_transaction_period. - Both joins are required; rows missing either rate are excluded. - Compute converted amounts by multiplying unconverted_amount by the corresponding exchange rate after converting both to numeric; no rounding is applied, the sign is preserved, and the result is NULL if either input is NULL. - Left join staging.stg_netsuite__accounts on account_id to derive: - is_income_statement: TRUE when type_name (case-insensitive) is one of income, other income, expense, other expense, or cost of goods sold; otherwise FALSE (including NULL). - account_category from type_name (case-insensitive): Asset (accounts receivable, bank, deferred expense, fixed asset, other asset, other current asset, unbilled receivable, prepaid expense), Expense (cost of goods sold, expense, other expense), Income (income, other income), Liability (accounts payable, credit card, deferred revenue, long term liability, other current liability), Equity (equity, retained earnings, net income), Other (non posting, statistical); else NULL. - Output includes all base and derived fields; one row per transaction_line_id that meets the inner-join conditions.'
