alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN pct >= 0.9 THEN 'Critical Dependency' WHEN pct >= 0.7 THEN 'High Dependency' WHEN pct >= 0.5 THEN 'Medium Dependency' WHEN pct >= 0.3 THEN 'Low Dependency' ELSE 'Minimal Dependency' END

CASE WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 730 AND active_months >= 12 THEN 'Very Stable' WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 365 AND active_months >= 6 THEN 'Stable' WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 180 AND active_months >= 3 THEN 'Developing' WHEN vendor_relationship_days >= 90 THEN 'New Relationship' ELSE 'Very New' END
CASE WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 30 THEN 'Active' WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 90 THEN 'Recent' WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 180 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Dormant' END

CASE WHEN dependency_level = 'Critical Dependency' THEN 30 WHEN dependency_level = 'High Dependency' THEN 20 WHEN dependency_level = 'Medium Dependency' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END + CASE WHEN overdue_payment_percentage >= 50 THEN 25 WHEN overdue_payment_percentage >= 30 THEN 20 WHEN overdue_payment_percentage >= 15 THEN 15 WHEN overdue_payment_percentage > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN spend_concentration_ratio >= 0.2 THEN 25 WHEN spend_concentration_ratio >= 0.1 THEN 15 WHEN spend_concentration_ratio >= 0.05 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END + CASE WHEN activity_status = 'Dormant' THEN 20 WHEN activity_status = 'Inactive' THEN 15 WHEN activity_status = 'Recent' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN vendor_risk_score >= 70 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN vendor_risk_score >= 50 THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN vendor_risk_score >= 30 THEN 'Low Risk' ELSE 'Minimal Risk' END

CASE WHEN dependency_level IN ('Critical Dependency', 'High Dependency') AND spend_concentration_ratio >= 0.1 THEN 'High Business Impact' WHEN dependency_level = 'Medium Dependency' AND total_vendor_spend >= 10000 THEN 'Medium Business Impact' WHEN total_vendor_spend >= 5000 THEN 'Low Business Impact' ELSE 'Minimal Business Impact' END

CASE WHEN dependency_level = 'Critical Dependency' AND relationship_stability IN ('Very Stable', 'Stable') THEN 'Strategic Partner' WHEN dependency_level IN ('High Dependency', 'Critical Dependency') THEN 'Key Supplier' WHEN dependency_level = 'Medium Dependency' THEN 'Important Supplier' WHEN dependency_level = 'Low Dependency' THEN 'Regular Supplier' ELSE 'Occasional Supplier' END

CASE WHEN dependency_level = 'Critical Dependency' AND overdue_payment_percentage > 20 THEN 'Urgent' WHEN dependency_level IN ('Critical Dependency', 'High Dependency') THEN 'High Priority' WHEN dependency_level = 'Medium Dependency' AND overdue_payment_percentage > 0 THEN 'Medium Priority' WHEN overdue_payment_percentage > 30 THEN 'Payment Focus' ELSE 'Standard Management' END

CASE WHEN vendor_risk_score >= 70 AND dependency_level = 'Critical Dependency' THEN 'Diversify supplier base urgently' WHEN vendor_risk_score >= 70 THEN 'Review vendor relationship and payment terms' WHEN dependency_level = 'Critical Dependency' AND overdue_payment_percentage > 0 THEN 'Prioritize payment processing' WHEN spend_concentration_ratio >= 0.2 THEN 'Consider supplier diversification' WHEN overdue_payment_percentage >= 30 THEN 'Improve payment processing' WHEN activity_status = 'Dormant' AND total_vendor_spend > 0 THEN 'Review vendor status' ELSE 'Maintain current relationship' END
CASE WHEN subsidiary_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MD5(vendor_id || '_' || subsidiary_id || '_' || CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS TEXT)) END

business_logic: '- Build vendor_transactions: - Join transaction_details to transaction_lines on transaction_line_id (inner), then to transactions on transaction_id (left). - Keep rows where vendor_id (from transaction_lines.entity_id) is present and account_type_name is one of AcctPay, Expense, or COGS. - Derive vendor fields: vendor_name is "Vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email is "vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id and the domain "@vendor.com"; vendor_category_name is "General Supplier"; carry subsidiary_id from transaction_details. - Transaction/date fields: transaction_date from transactions; due_date from transactions; analysis_month is the month of accounting_period_ending. - Payment metrics per line: days_from_due_date is the day difference between the due date and today (use transaction_date when due date is missing; positive means overdue, negatives allowed); payable_amount is the absolute amount only for AcctPay with negative converted_amount, else 0; expense_amount is the absolute amount only for Expense or COGS, else 0. - Aggregate vendor_financial_metrics grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_category_name, subsidiary_id: - total_transactions is the count of distinct transaction_id. - active_months is the count of distinct analysis_month. - total_payables is the sum of payable_amount; total_expenses is the sum of expense_amount; total_vendor_spend is the sum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - avg_payable_amount is the average of payable_amount over lines with payable_amount > 0 (NULL if none). - max_transaction_amount is the maximum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - first_transaction_date is the earliest transaction_date; last_transaction_date is the latest transaction_date. - vendor_relationship_days is the day difference between first and last transaction_date (NULL if either date is NULL). - avg_payment_delay is the average days_from_due_date over lines with payable_amount > 0 (negatives possible; NULL if none). - overdue_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0 and days_from_due_date > 0; total_payable_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0. - days_since_last_transaction is the day difference between last_transaction_date and today (NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL). - analysis_date is set to today. - Compute vendor_dependency_analysis: - dependency_level uses total_vendor_spend compared to percentile thresholds of total_vendor_spend across all vendors: ≥90th → Critical Dependency; ≥70th → High Dependency; ≥50th → Medium Dependency; ≥30th → Low Dependency; otherwise Minimal Dependency. - overdue_payment_percentage is ((overdue_invoices / total_payable_invoices) × 100) rounded to 2 decimals; if total_payable_invoices = 0 then 0. - spend_concentration_ratio is total_vendor_spend divided by the total vendor spend within the same subsidiary_id; result is NULL when subsidiary_id is NULL. - relationship_stability: Very Stable if relationship_days ≥ 730 and active_months ≥ 12; Stable if ≥ 365 and ≥ 6; Developing if ≥ 180 and ≥ 3; New Relationship if ≥ 90; otherwise Very New. - activity_status: Active if days_since_last_transaction ≤ 30; Recent if ≤ 90; Inactive if ≤ 180; otherwise Dormant. - Compute vendor_risk_scoring: - vendor_risk_score is the sum of points: dependency_level (Critical 30, High 20, Medium 10, else 5) + overdue_payment_percentage (≥50 → 25, ≥30 → 20, ≥15 → 15, >0 → 10, else 0) + spend_concentration_ratio (≥0.2 → 25, ≥0.1 → 15, ≥0.05 → 10, else 5) + activity_status (Dormant 20, Inactive 15, Recent 5, Active 0). - business_impact_level: High Business Impact if dependency is Critical/High and concentration ≥ 0.1; Medium Business Impact if dependency is Medium and total_vendor_spend ≥ 10,000; Low Business Impact if total_vendor_spend ≥ 5,000; otherwise Minimal Business Impact. - supplier_tier: Strategic Partner if dependency is Critical and relationship is Very Stable/Stable; Key Supplier if dependency is High or Critical; Important Supplier if Medium; Regular Supplier if Low; otherwise Occasional Supplier. - management_priority: Urgent if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 20; High Priority if dependency is Critical/High; Medium Priority if dependency is Medium and overdue_payment_percentage > 0; Payment Focus if overdue_payment_percentage > 30; otherwise Standard Management. - Compute vendor_recommendations: - risk_level by vendor_risk_score: ≥70 High Risk; ≥50 Medium Risk; ≥30 Low Risk; otherwise Minimal Risk. - recommended_action: if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 and dependency is Critical then Diversify supplier base urgently; else if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 then Review vendor relationship and payment terms; else if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 0 then Prioritize payment processing; else if spend_concentration_ratio ≥ 0.2 then Consider supplier diversification; else if overdue_payment_percentage ≥ 30 then Improve payment processing; else if activity_status is Dormant and total_vendor_spend > 0 then Review vendor status; otherwise Maintain current relationship. - contract_recommendation by supplier_tier: Strategic Partner → Long-term strategic contract with SLA; Key Supplier → Multi-year contract with performance metrics; Important Supplier → Annual contract with review clause; otherwise Standard purchase agreement. - payment_recommendation: if overdue_payment_percentage > 50 then Immediate payment processing review; else if > 20 then Expedite payment processing; else if supplier_tier is Strategic Partner then Consider early payment discounts; otherwise Standard payment terms. - Final output: - Keep rows where vendor_id is not null and total_vendor_spend > 0. - Compute vendor_risk_analysis_id as the MD5 hash of the string "vendor_id_subsidiary_id_analysis_date" (components joined with underscores); result is NULL if any component is NULL. - Order rows by vendor_risk_score descending, then total_vendor_spend descending.'

Key Supplier → Multi-year contract with performance metrics; Important Supplier → Annual contract with review clause; otherwise Standard purchase agreement. - payment_recommendation: if overdue_payment_percentage > 50 then Immediate payment processing review; else if > 20 then Expedite payment processing; else if supplier_tier is Strategic Partner then Consider early payment discounts; otherwise Standard payment terms. - Final output: - Keep rows where vendor_id is not null and total_vendor_spend > 0. - Compute vendor_risk_analysis_id as the MD5 hash of the string "vendor_id_subsidiary_id_analysis_date" (components joined with underscores); result is NULL if any component is NULL. - Order rows by vendor_risk_score descending, then total_vendor_spend descending.'

business_logic: '- Build vendor_transactions: - Join transaction_details to transaction_lines on transaction_line_id (inner), then to transactions on transaction_id (left). - Keep rows where vendor_id (from transaction_lines.entity_id) is present and account_type_name is one of AcctPay, Expense, or COGS. - Derive vendor fields: vendor_name is "Vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email is "vendor_" plus the first 8 characters of vendor_id and the domain "@vendor.com"; vendor_category_name is "General Supplier"; carry subsidiary_id from transaction_details. - Transaction/date fields: transaction_date from transactions; due_date from transactions; analysis_month is the month of accounting_period_ending. - Payment metrics per line: days_from_due_date is the day difference between the due date and today (use transaction_date when due date is missing; positive means overdue, negatives allowed); payable_amount is the absolute amount only for AcctPay with negative converted_amount, else 0; expense_amount is the absolute amount only for Expense or COGS, else 0. - Aggregate vendor_financial_metrics grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_category_name, subsidiary_id: - total_transactions is the count of distinct transaction_id. - active_months is the count of distinct analysis_month. - total_payables is the sum of payable_amount; total_expenses is the sum of expense_amount; total_vendor_spend is the sum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - avg_payable_amount is the average of payable_amount over lines with payable_amount > 0 (NULL if none). - max_transaction_amount is the maximum of payable_amount plus expense_amount. - first_transaction_date is the earliest transaction_date; last_transaction_date is the latest transaction_date. - vendor_relationship_days is the day difference between first and last transaction_date (NULL if either date is NULL). - avg_payment_delay is the average days_from_due_date over lines with payable_amount > 0 (negatives possible; NULL if none). - overdue_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0 and days_from_due_date > 0; total_payable_invoices counts lines where payable_amount > 0. - days_since_last_transaction is the day difference between last_transaction_date and today (NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL). - analysis_date is set to today. - Compute vendor_dependency_analysis: - dependency_level uses total_vendor_spend compared to percentile thresholds of total_vendor_spend across all vendors: ≥90th → Critical Dependency; ≥70th → High Dependency; ≥50th → Medium Dependency; ≥30th → Low Dependency; otherwise Minimal Dependency. - overdue_payment_percentage is ((overdue_invoices / total_payable_invoices) × 100) rounded to 2 decimals; if total_payable_invoices = 0 then 0. - spend_concentration_ratio is total_vendor_spend divided by the total vendor spend within the same subsidiary_id; result is NULL when subsidiary_id is NULL. - relationship_stability: Very Stable if relationship_days ≥ 730 and active_months ≥ 12; Stable if ≥ 365 and ≥ 6; Developing if ≥ 180 and ≥ 3; New Relationship if ≥ 90; otherwise Very New. - activity_status: Active if days_since_last_transaction ≤ 30; Recent if ≤ 90; Inactive if ≤ 180; otherwise Dormant. - Compute vendor_risk_scoring: - vendor_risk_score is the sum of points: dependency_level (Critical 30, High 20, Medium 10, else 5) + overdue_payment_percentage (≥50 → 25, ≥30 → 20, ≥15 → 15, >0 → 10, else 0) + spend_concentration_ratio (≥0.2 → 25, ≥0.1 → 15, ≥0.05 → 10, else 5) + activity_status (Dormant 20, Inactive 15, Recent 5, Active 0). - business_impact_level: High Business Impact if dependency is Critical/High and concentration ≥ 0.1; Medium Business Impact if dependency is Medium and total_vendor_spend ≥ 10,000; Low Business Impact if total_vendor_spend ≥ 5,000; otherwise Minimal Business Impact. - supplier_tier: Strategic Partner if dependency is Critical and relationship is Very Stable/Stable; Key Supplier if dependency is High or Critical; Important Supplier if Medium; Regular Supplier if Low; otherwise Occasional Supplier. - management_priority: Urgent if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 20; High Priority if dependency is Critical/High; Medium Priority if dependency is Medium and overdue_payment_percentage > 0; Payment Focus if overdue_payment_percentage > 30; otherwise Standard Management. - Compute vendor_recommendations: - risk_level by vendor_risk_score: ≥70 High Risk; ≥50 Medium Risk; ≥30 Low Risk; otherwise Minimal Risk. - recommended_action: if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 and dependency is Critical then Diversify supplier base urgently; else if vendor_risk_score ≥ 70 then Review vendor relationship and payment terms; else if dependency is Critical and overdue_payment_percentage > 0 then Prioritize payment processing; else if spend_concentration_ratio ≥ 0.2 then Consider supplier diversification; else if overdue_payment_percentage ≥ 30 then Improve payment processing; else if activity_status is Dormant and total_vendor_spend > 0 then Review vendor status; otherwise Maintain current relationship. - contract_recommendation by supplier_tier: Strategic Partner → Long-term strategic contract with SLA; Key Supplier → Multi-year contract with performance metrics; Important Supplier → Annual contract with review clause; otherwise Standard purchase agreement. - payment_recommendation: if overdue_payment_percentage > 50 then Immediate payment processing review; else if > 20 then Expedite payment processing; else if supplier_tier is Strategic Partner then Consider early payment discounts; otherwise Standard payment terms. - Final output: - Keep rows where vendor_id is not null and total_vendor_spend > 0. - Compute vendor_risk_analysis_id as the MD5 hash of the string "vendor_id_subsidiary_id_analysis_date" (components joined with underscores); result is NULL if any component is NULL. - Order rows by vendor_risk_score descending, then total_vendor_spend descending.'

- name: netsuite__balance_sheet
      description: Balance sheet view built from transaction lines with period-aware currency conversion, account mapping, and a synthetic CTA row
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id per reporting accounting_period_id per output account_name (includes synthetic CTA rows)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite__subsidiaries
      business_logic: 'Inputs - transactions_with_converted_amounts: precomputed transaction-level amounts including converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period and converted_amount_using_reporting_month, plus transaction_id, transaction_line_id, account_id, account_category, reporting_accounting_period_id, transaction_accounting_period_id, is_income_statement. - accounts: account metadata including account_id, name, type_name, account_number, is_balancesheet, is_leftside, general_rate_type. - accounting_periods: accounting period attributes including accounting_period_id, name, full_name, ending_at, is_adjustment, is_closed, year_id, fiscal_calendar_id. - subsidiaries: used only to select the fiscal_calendar_id of the top-level parent subsidiary (row with parent_id IS NULL). Steps 1) Join accounts to transactions on account_id (IDs compared as strings). 2) Join reporting_accounting_periods by reporting_accounting_period_id and transaction_accounting_periods by transaction_accounting_period_id (IDs compared as strings). 3) Restrict to periods in the top-level fiscal calendar: - reporting_accounting_periods.fiscal_calendar_id must equal the fiscal_calendar_id of the parentless subsidiary. - transaction_accounting_periods.fiscal_calendar_id must also equal that same fiscal_calendar_id (base rows only). 4) Keep rows where either the account is a balance sheet account (is_balancesheet equals true, case-insensitive ''t'') or the transaction is flagged is_income_statement = true. 5) Produce base balance sheet rows: - Period fields come from reporting_accounting_periods. - account_name and account_type_name: - If account is not a balance sheet account: - If reporting and transaction accounting periods are in the same fiscal year → "Net Income" - Else → "Retained Earnings" - Otherwise use accounts.name / accounts.type_name. - account_id and account_number are NULL for non-balance-sheet accounts; otherwise taken from accounts (account_id represented as a string). - converted_amount selection (all string comparisons case-insensitive): - If non-balance-sheet account and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → negative of converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if non-balance-sheet account: → negative of converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = false and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → negative of converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = true and general_rate_type in {historical, average}: → converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = false: → negative of converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else if balance-sheet account and is_leftside = true: → converted_amount_using_reporting_month - Else → 0. Note: If the chosen source amount is NULL, the result is NULL; the literal 0 applies only when no predicate matched. - balance_sheet_sort_helper (case-insensitive on accounts.type_name): bank→1; accounts receivable→2; unbilled receivable→3; other current asset→4; fixed asset→5; other asset→6; deferred expense→7; accounts payable→8; credit card→9; other current liability→10; long term liability→11; deferred revenue→12; equity→13; non-balance-sheet with same year (Net Income)→15; other non-balance-sheet (Retained Earnings)→14; else NULL. 6) Union ALL a synthetic CTA row for each qualifying transaction line and reporting period: - account_category = ''Equity''; account_name = ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment''; account_type_name = ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment''; account_id = NULL; account_number = NULL. - converted_amount: - If the transaction''s account_category is ''equity'' (case-insensitive) OR is_income_statement = true: → converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period - Else → converted_amount_using_reporting_month. - balance_sheet_sort_helper = 16. - Join only reporting_accounting_periods and apply the same reporting fiscal calendar filter and the same inclusion filter (account is balance sheet OR is_income_statement). No transaction-period calendar filter here. 7) Booleans is_accounting_period_adjustment and is_accounting_period_closed are true only when the corresponding period flag equals "yes" (case-insensitive), false otherwise, and NULL when the source flag is NULL. 8) No aggregation or deduplication is performed; UNION ALL preserves duplicates across scenarios.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts; duplicates allowed across rows
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction line identifier; may appear twice per period when a CTA row is generated
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Reporting accounting period identifier from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period end from accounting_periods.ending_at as stored
      - name: accounting_period_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period full_name from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting period short name from stg_netsuite__accounting_periods
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when reporting period adjustment flag equals 'yes' (case-insensitive); NULL when source is NULL; false otherwise
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when reporting period closed flag equals 'yes' (case-insensitive); NULL when source is NULL; false otherwise
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For base rows: passthrough from transactions; for CTA rows: literal ''Equity'''
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Base rows: account name or remapped to ''Net Income''/''Retained Earnings'' for non-BS accounts; CTA rows: ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'''
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Base rows: account type or remapped to ''Net Income''/''Retained Earnings'' for non-BS accounts; CTA rows: ''Cumulative Translation Adjustment'''
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: accounts.account_id (as string) for balance-sheet accounts; NULL for non-balance-sheet and CTA rows
      - name: account_number
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: accounts.account_number for balance-sheet accounts; NULL for non-balance-sheet and CTA rows
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Signed converted amount selected from precomputed fields per deterministic rules (BS vs non-BS, left/right side, rate type, CTA logic); if chosen source is NULL the result is NULL; 0 only when no condition matched
      - name: balance_sheet_sort_helper
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Deterministic sort key: types map to 1–13; non-BS: Retained Earnings=14, Net Income=15; CTA=16; NULL otherwise'

- name: netsuite__income_statement
      description: Income statement rows from NetSuite transaction lines aligned to the root fiscal calendar and reporting period, with account and dimensional context and a normalized converted amount
      grain: One row per (transaction_id, transaction_line_id)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite__accounting_periods

missing IDs yield NULL full_name values. - Inner join accounts on account_id to bring account name, type, number, and to build the combined label. - Inner join accounting_periods on reporting_accounting_period_id; filter to periods in the root fiscal calendar (the fiscal calendar of the subsidiary with no parent), and require transaction_accounting_period_id equals reporting_accounting_period_id. - Inner join subsidiaries on subsidiary_id. - Filter to rows where is_income_statement is true; false and NULL are excluded. - Derivations: • is_accounting_period_adjustment: true only when the reporting period''s adjustment flag equals "yes" (case-insensitive); false for other non-null values; NULL when the flag is NULL. • is_accounting_period_closed: true only when the reporting period''s closed flag equals "yes" (case-insensitive); false for other non-null values; NULL when the flag is NULL. • account_number_and_name: concatenate account_number, a hyphen, and account_name; result is NULL if either part is NULL; original formatting is preserved. • converted_amount: the negated converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period; NULL if the source amount is NULL; no rounding. • income_statement_sort_helper: case-insensitive mapping of account_type_name to income=1, cost of goods sold=2, expense=3, other income=4, other expense=5; otherwise NULL. - Output exactly the selected fields; there is no aggregation, ordering, or de-duplication beyond the joins and filters; grain is one row per (transaction_id, transaction_line_id).'
